definitions.gloss: local bus; route bus; city bus
definitions.explanation: A public bus that runs on a fixed route with scheduled stops, serving everyday commuters and residents. Distinguished from chartered buses and long-distance express buses.

examples.japanese: {路線|ろせん}バス⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{通勤|つうきん}→通勤：03512_tsuukin⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{路線|ろせん}バス⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{本数|ほんすう}→本数：13154_honsuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧。
examples.english: This area has few local bus services.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人口|じんこう}{減少|げんしょう}→人口減少：24385_jinkougenshou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{路線|ろせん}バス⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{廃止|はいし}→廃止：12483_haishi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{全国|ぜんこく}→全国：03311_zenkoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{相次|あいつ}いでいる→相次ぐ：14869_aitsugu⟧。
examples.english: Local bus routes are being discontinued one after another across the country due to population decline.

notes:
An important part of daily transportation in Japan, especially in areas without train service. In recent years, {路線|ろせん}バス⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{廃止|はいし}→廃止：12483_haishi⟧ (discontinuation of bus routes) has become a major social issue in rural Japan as population decline makes routes financially unviable.

FORMS:
⟦{路線|ろせん}→路線：11341_rosen⟧ (route, line) + ⟦バス→バス：00769_basu⟧ (bus)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {路線|ろせん}バス⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧: to ride a local bus
- {路線|ろせん}バス⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時刻表|じこくひょう}→時刻表：01031_jikokuhyou⟧: local bus timetable
- {路線|ろせん}バス⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{運賃|うんちん}→運賃：05299_unchin⟧: local bus fare
- {路線|ろせん}バス⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{廃止|はいし}→廃止：12483_haishi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: a bus route is discontinued

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{高速|こうそく}バス→高速バス：20782_kousokubasu⟧: express bus, highway bus — long-distance, between cities
- ⟦{貸切|かしきり}バス→貸切バス：22719_kashikiribasu⟧: chartered bus — for private group use
- コミュニティバス: community bus — small buses serving local neighborhoods, often subsidized
